newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf rises on results in weaker market.
newsitem.headline: Elf rises on results in weaker market.

text.p: Shares in oil group Elf Aquitaine jumped in a slightly weaker market after the company reported 1996 results in line with expectations and increased its dividend.
At 1228 GMT, Elf shares were up 1.48 percent at 550 francs while the CAC-40 index was down 0.1 percent.
"There was certainly a marked improvement in results from the production and exploration side," Salomon Brothers analyst Gordon Gray told Reuters Financial Television.
Elf aims to raise its return on equity to at least 10 percent in 1998, from 9.5 percent in 1996, and to 12 percent later.
"Our numbers are indicating that they should be able to achieve that kind of return," Salomon's Gray said, adding he believed Elf remained one of the best stocks in the energy sector.
